diagnosis: The lone decision-maker passed checks C2 and C4 because the rollout settlements adhered to default values for the relevant facts. Specifically, rollout 1 set 'horse_rest_break_minutes' to 30 minutes (default value for PF2), and rollout 3 set 'wrap_time' to 23:00 (default value for PF4). These default values allowed the checks to pass without requiring any interaction with the hidden information.
